subject: Linguistics
title: Roots and Stems
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Roots and Stems.

hook.text: 'Unhappiness' strips down to 'happy'—that core is called the root.

buildup.text: The root carries the primary meaning; everything else modifies or extends it.

discovery.text: A stem is the root plus any derivational affixes—'unhappy' is the stem that '-ness' attaches to.

twist.text: Arabic roots are just three consonants—vowels weave through them to create different words.

climax.text: Knowing the root of a word lets you guess the meaning of related words you've never seen.

punchline.text: Find the root and the whole word family opens up.
